user.title: mBenzin access key
user.description: Enter your personal access key for mBenzin.cz. You can get it for free by e-mail: write to reklama@mbenzin.cz, say you use the prices in Home Assistant, for which city or stations, and how often you load them. The key is personal, never share it.

data_description.key: The key mBenzin.cz sent you. Paste it whole, without spaces.

city.title: City
city.description: Choose your city. Only the stations of this city are shown, not those of the whole region.

fuels.title: Fuels and language
fuels.description: Pick one or more fuels – for example Natural 95 and LPG for a dual-fuel car. Each fuel gets its own sensors. Note that mBenzin does not distinguish E10: the Natural 95 price applies to all 95-octane petrol.

data_description.language: Sets the language of the labels in the ready-made dashboard views (for example "My station"). The language of this setup follows Home Assistant's language.

station.title: Favourite station – {fuel}
station.description: Your usual station in {city} for {fuel}. It gets its own sensor with price history, trends and its rank in town. Leave "—" for none.

error.invalid_auth: mBenzin did not accept the key. Check that it is pasted whole and without spaces.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach mBenzin.cz. Please try again.
error.rate_limited: mBenzin returned HTTP 429 (limit: 20 pages per hour). Try again in a moment.
